author: Notalgicular
body:
Hey guys, as you may know I have a small channel doing 1v1s or anything PvP related on minecraft.
I say small. I have just started it, and I'd love to see it grow. 
Heres the kind of things I'll be doing on my channel, 1v1s, montages, and other videos.

Heres what the thread is about though, my channel trailer!
View it here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VOvud4zfuiY&index=1&list=UUuKO1unyfLXtdzQgtVhGJaQ


If you want to see more videos, or if you can just support me, leaving 1 sub would mean alot! :D

Ty,
Notal :o
